speech.title: Text to Speech
speech.heading: Give any text a
speech.subtitle: Paste a script, a caption or a whole chapter and hear it read by MiniMax, ElevenLabs or Gemini voices. Pick the voice, the emotion and the pace from the bar, or clone your own voice from a short sample and use it like any other.
speech.placeholder: Write what should be said, for example: Welcome back. Today we look at three ways to make a small kitchen feel twice its size.

starters.label: Warm product intro
starters.prompt: Meet Lumen, the lamp that learns your evenings. It dims as you wind down, brightens when you read, and never needs a switch.

starters.label: Audiobook opening line
starters.prompt: The rain had stopped an hour ago, but the gutters still argued about it, dripping onto the tin roof of the shed where Mara kept her maps.

starters.label: Short tutorial step
starters.prompt: Step three. Hold the fabric taut with your left hand and feed it slowly under the needle. Let the machine set the pace, not your wrist.

dialogue.title: Dialogue
dialogue.heading: A cast, a script, one
dialogue.subtitle: Name the speakers, give each a voice, then write the lines in order. ElevenLabs and Gemini read the whole scene in one take, with tone tags like [whispers] or [laughs] where you put them.

starters.label: Two friends, one plan
starters.prompt:
Speaker 1: [excited] Okay, hear me out. We leave Friday, drive through the night, and watch the sunrise from the pass.
Speaker 2: [sceptical] And sleep where, exactly?
Speaker 1: In the car. Like adventurers.
Speaker 2: [laughs] Like people with back pain.

starters.label: Customer support call
starters.prompt:
Speaker 1: Thanks for calling Northwind, this is Dana. How can I help?
Speaker 2: Hi Dana. My order shows delivered, but nothing came.
Speaker 1: [reassuring] I'm sorry about that. Let me check where the driver scanned it.

music.title: Music
music.heading: Describe a track, get a
music.subtitle: Lyria, MiniMax, Mureka and ElevenLabs write full songs and instrumentals from a style prompt, with your lyrics where the model sings. MM Audio turns the same bar into sound effects.
music.placeholder: Genre, mood, tempo and instruments. For example: warm acoustic folk, fingerpicked guitar, brushed drums
music.lyricsPlaceholder:
Write the words, one line per line.
A blank line adds a pause.

starters.label: Late-night lo-fi
starters.prompt: Lo-fi hip hop instrumental, 80 bpm, dusty piano chords, vinyl crackle, soft sidechained bass, rain outside

starters.label: Festival anthem
starters.prompt: Big festival pop anthem, 128 bpm, bright synths, four-on-the-floor kick, a huge singalong chorus, euphoric

starters.label: Film score cue
starters.prompt: Cinematic orchestral cue, slow build from a solo cello to full strings and brass, tense then triumphant, no drums until the end

music.sfxPlaceholder: Describe the sound. For example: heavy rain on a tin roof, distant thunder, a door creaking shut

remix.title: Remix
remix.heading: Take a track somewhere
remix.subtitle: Drop in a song or pick one from your library. Stable Audio restyles it from a prompt, keeping as much of the original as you like. Mureka extends a song with a new section and the lyrics it should sing.
remix.placeholder: The new style or sound, for example: slower, dreamier, swap the drums for brushed percussion

controls.extendFromTitle: Where the new part starts, in seconds from the beginning

picker.remixSection: A track in, a track out

script.profileHint: Gemini shapes the voice from this description.
script.scenePlaceholder: A quiet, warm room late at night

clone.title: Clone a voice
clone.hint: A clean 10 to 60 second sample of one person speaking, no music. MiniMax returns a voice you can pick for any MiniMax speech model. The sample is uploaded to the provider you run it on.
clone.sampleHint: MP3, WAV or M4A up to 20 MB
clone.name: Voice id
clone.nameHint: At least 8 characters, letters and numbers, starting with a letter. This is how the voice is named everywhere.
clone.previewPlaceholder: Hi, this is a quick test of my cloned voice.
clone.badName: The voice id needs 8 or more characters, letters and numbers, starting with a letter.

remix.dropHint: MP3, WAV or M4A. Songs from the Music page work too.
remix.libraryEmpty: No tracks yet. Generate one on the Music page, or upload here.
remix.readyHint: {model} will work from the track above.

gallery.pendingHint: Speech takes seconds, music a minute or two. You can keep working.

confirm.deleteItem: Delete this track from the library?
confirm.deleteVoice: Forget this voice? Tracks made with it stay.

providers.needKey: Audio models run on {providers}. Add a key in Settings → Providers to start.

errors.notAudio: Only MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC files can be used.
errors.needText: Write the text to speak first.
errors.needScript: Give at least one speaker a line.
errors.needLyrics: This model sings lyrics. Add some, or switch to instrumental.
errors.needSource: Add a track to work from first.
